overview.title: Land, major architecture and heritage
overview.introduction: Twelve competencies, organised around three imperatives: understand, design, secure.
overview.supporting: Three complementary fields to structure, steer and secure complex projects.
overview.governance: Across all three pillars, ARCHERITAGE applies the same standard: structure responsibilities, document decisions and clarify trade-offs — formalised in PATRIGOV.
overview.finalCta: Let us identify together the expertise and engagement format suited to your project.

understand.title: Understand heritage
understand.introduction: Build solid knowledge of the place before any transformation.

cards.title: Heritage architecture
cards.text: Read architectural values, uses and the evolution potential of heritage buildings, fabrics and sites.

cards.title: Heritage and architectural diagnosis
cards.text: Qualify condition, vulnerabilities, constraints and possible intervention directions.

cards.title: Historical, constructive and material reading
cards.text: Understand construction systems, materials, traces and successive transformations of the built fabric.

transform.title: Transform with judgement
transform.introduction: Reconcile conservation, use, feasibility and architectural quality.

cards.title: Restoration, rehabilitation and adaptive reuse
cards.text: Define a responsible intervention attentive to the place’s value and its new use trajectory.

cards.title: Heritage, territory and urban identity
cards.text: Situate the project within its urban, cultural, social and territorial context.

cards.title: Valorisation, transmission and heritage narrative
cards.text: Make history, choices and know-how legible in order to better transmit heritage value.

master.title: Master complex projects
master.introduction: Give project owners a clear view of responsibilities, risks and real progress.

cards.title: Project ownership and institutional projects
cards.text: Frame the need, prepare decisions and support sensitive phases of an operation.

cards.title: Documentary governance and traceability
cards.text: Organise documents, validations and the memory of trade-offs.

cards.title: Steering of complex heritage worksites
cards.text: Coordinate information, track risks and support decisions during execution.

cards.title: Audit, recovery and project securing
cards.text: Analyse gaps, reconstruct facts and restore an operational control framework.

decide.title: Structure decision-making
decide.introduction: Turn complexity into useful, ranked and actionable information.

cards.title: Frameworks, methods and tools
cards.text: Create procedures, matrices and dashboards suited to the project’s real functioning.

cards.title: Strategic heritage advisory
cards.text: Clarify orientations, investment priorities and valorisation trajectories.

detailCta.title: Mobilise the expertises useful to your project
detailCta.text: Archeritage shapes its engagement according to the place, the stakes and the complexity of the operation.
detailCta.label: Contact us

valorisation-fonciere.title: Land and territorial valorisation
valorisation-fonciere.introduction: Understand a site’s potential and structure a land operation before structuring decisions.
valorisation-fonciere.imageAlt: Aerial view of a land site structured by its plots and access routes
competencies: Territorial valorisation strategies for public authorities and investors
Regulatory analysis and structuring of complex land operations
projectNeeds: Assess a site before acquisition or decision
valorisation-fonciere.patrigovConnection: Complex land operations require rigorous documentary governance: structure responsibilities, document trade-offs and secure decisions at every stage.
valorisation-fonciere.contactCtaLabel: Present a site or an operation

architecture-projets-envergure.title: Architecture and major projects
architecture-projets-envergure.introduction: Design, coordinate and steer public buildings, collective facilities and multi-stakeholder operations.
architecture-projets-envergure.imageAlt: Contemporary architecture of a large-scale facility
competencies: Architectural design of public buildings and collective facilities
Coordination of multi-stakeholder and institutional projects
Delegated project ownership and owner’s advisory support
Audit, recovery and securing of projects in difficulty
projectNeeds: Design a building or a facility
Secure a complex or distressed project
architecture-projets-envergure.patrigovConnection: Multi-stakeholder projects require clear governance: validation circuits, responsibility matrix, decision traceability and secured trade-offs.

valorisation-patrimoine.title: Heritage valorisation
valorisation-patrimoine.introduction: Diagnose, restore, rehabilitate and revalue built heritage — from reading the place to its territorial enhancement.
valorisation-patrimoine.imageAlt: Heritage ensemble of the Tiznit kasbah and Mechouar square
competencies: Heritage diagnosis and historical, constructive and material reading
Restoration, rehabilitation and adaptive reuse of historic buildings
Territorial valorisation of historic sites, kasbahs and medinas
projectNeeds: Understand and diagnose a historic building
Valorise a historic site within its territory
valorisation-patrimoine.patrigovConnection: Heritage restoration demands impeccable documentation: every decision, trade-off and intervention must be traceable and legally secured.
